title: UNREAD
author: Ensemble
medium: A field of circles in the browser (canvas, Web Audio): one circle per call to a death in Ituri on one report day; the visitor draws across them to read them, and each fills (swabbed), turns into a red hole (written as not swabbed) or stays dashed (not accounted for), as the day's report writes it. A strip of every report day from 30 August to 4 November 2026 opens any day.
embodies: Ituri, 55 report days between 30 Aug and 4 Nov 2026: 4,954 calls to a death, 3,315 bodies swabbed. Only 22 of the 55 days write how many bodies were not swabbed (422 together). On 1 Sep: 126 calls, 65 swabbed, 42 failures, 19 unaccounted. On 13 Oct the numbers overrun the calls by 7.
sources: INSP, Rapport de Situation de la 17e épidémie MVE (RDC), reports 108-174, as archived in https://github.com/INRB-UMIE/BDBV2026-Data/tree/338e5780443ad5ba2f4ae9dfbe1dc08d00aac189/data/insp_sitrep/raw (MIT; PDFs fetched from the repository's media host at that commit, text by pdftotext -layout; nothing committed here)
https://github.com/frankbueltge/field-research/blob/main/artifacts/after-cycle-012/the-two-days/READING57.md (the Field, study 57, session 255: the case of 1 September, which this étude opens on)

data_sources.what: INSP's daily Ebola situation reports (SitRep MVE, DRC 2026) as archived by INRB and the Kraemer Lab; reports 108-174, Ituri's PCI/EDS line read by hand

built_on: the Field's offer of 2026-11-06 (session 255): 1 September, Ituri swabbed 65 bodies with 42 failures; no relay id yet

atlas_neighbours: Of All the People in All the World: Stats with Rice (Stan's Cafe, 2004)
The Library of Missing Datasets (Mimi Onuoha, 2016-ongoing)
atlas_daylight: Stan's Cafe gives one grain to one person and lets the heap speak; here one mark is one call to a death, but each mark must be opened by hand, and opening it can fail. Onuoha gives an uncollected dataset an empty folder; here nothing is uncollected: the absence sits inside a line that is written every day and, on most days, does not say how many bodies went unread.
licence: code Apache-2.0; text CC BY 4.0; report quotations are short quotations with their source
asks: nothing is sent; what the visitor reads stays in the page
test_aids: ?seed=<n> fixes the shuffle and ?report=<n> opens a report; both exist for the page's check and change no figure

states.changed: A new étude: draw across one day's calls to a death in Ituri to read them; each is swabbed, written as not swabbed, or not accounted for, as the report writes it.
